description: Land Acquisition - Ganegama South & Walpita-North, Baddegama D/S Division, Galle District
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific lands for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land parcels (lots 01-15) with their locations, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses exclusively on land acquisition matters, which falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative actions.
